contexts.text: Thus these things cohere; (but otherwise) they do not cohere.
The scientifics and truths in man's memory... cohere fascicularly... These coherences are more wonderful than any man can believe...
The consuming of cohering goods. Signified.
Coherence with the good of the whole Kingdom. Signified.
All coherence in the Spiritual World is effected through influx.
The formation of these falsities in order that they may cohere. Signified. AC 10406:4.
They do not know that all they know and think about the truths and goods of the Church does not at all cohere together. Signified.
With men who do not acknowledge one God, but a number, nothing of the Church coheres. Explained.
The universe is a work which coheres together from primes to ultimates.
Faith is perfected according to the abundance and coherence of truths. Explained.

In the minutest human fibres there is nothing solid, or cohering, and thus rigid; for if it cohered, or were rigid through coherence, it would be in the highest degree brittle... it is only corporeal things which can be said to cohere... The less coherent a thing is, or the less it resembles a solid, the more durable it is... Their coherence depends upon this, that all the particulars are yielding.
They shall not cohere the one with the other ()... The destruction of falsities not cohering with truths from the Word is here signified. AE 237:end. AE 411:4. AE 1029:5.

Jerusalem = the Church as to doctrine, which is said to be built as a city that is compact together (), when all the doctrines thereof are in agreement with each other and unanimous, and when they reciprocally regard the Lord and love to Him from Him as the beginning and the end.
